vision.name: Overwhelming Power
vision.text:
(Limit 2 per deck. This card is considered a Styled and Named card for your card effects. If this card is placed into your hand by a card effect, you may use a critical damage effect.)
If your MP's power level is higher than your opponent's MP's power level, destroy up to 2 Setups and/or Drills.
vision.note: grey (non-styled) frame; no 'POWER:' label printed (S14 P45 reprint has 'POWER:' and says 'non-Mastery card effect'); filename flag (CRD)
